```{python}
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path

from IPython.display import Image, Markdown, display

ROOT = Path.cwd().resolve()
WORKING_CONFIG = json.loads((ROOT / "configs" / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
STUDY = ROOT / WORKING_CONFIG["output_root"] / WORKING_CONFIG["study_id"]
RUN_ID = 1  # select one completed immutable experiment run before rendering
RUN = STUDY / "runs" / f"run-{RUN_ID}"
REPORTS = RUN / "reports"
CONFIG = json.loads((RUN / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if (RUN / "config.json").is_file() else WORKING_CONFIG
REQUIRED = [RUN / "run-manifest.json", RUN / "dsp-design.json", REPORTS / "metric-summary.csv", REPORTS / "factorial-bootstrap.json", REPORTS / "wiener-positive-control.json"]
missing = [str(path) for path in REQUIRED if not path.is_file()]
if missing:
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "Run from the project root first: `uv run python run.py all --config configs/config.json`; "
        "then select its completed RUN_ID. Missing:\n" + "\n".join(missing)
    )

MANIFEST = json.loads((RUN / "run-manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
DESIGN = json.loads((RUN / "dsp-design.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
POSITIVE = json.loads((REPORTS / "wiener-positive-control.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
FACTORIAL = json.loads((REPORTS / "factorial-bootstrap.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
with (REPORTS / "metric-summary.csv").open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    METRICS = list(csv.DictReader(stream))

def mean_accuracy(cell: str, family: str | None = None, clean: bool = False) -> float | None:
    values = [
        float(row["accuracy"])
        for row in METRICS
        if row["protocol"] == "unseen" and row["cell"] == cell
        and ((row["audio_domain"] == "clean") if clean else row["noise_family"] == family)
    ]
    return sum(values) / len(values) if values else None

def fmt(value: float | None) -> str:
    return "—" if value is None else f"{value:.3f}"
```

# Summary

This experiment freezes one `robust_cnn` speaker encoder per seed, trained on
clean VCTK with deterministic on-the-fly MUSAN augmentation. It then evaluates
the same pre-DSP mixture in all four inference-time cells: `raw`, `bandpass`,
`wiener`, and `bandpass_wiener`. Thus a cell difference is a front-end effect,
not a retraining effect.

The selected run is `{python} MANIFEST['run_tag']`; its manifest binds the
results to config hash `{python} MANIFEST['config_hash'][:12]}` and data-cache
hash `{python} MANIFEST['data_cache_hash']}`. The shared corpus/MUSAN cache is
stored separately under `cache/<data-config-hash>/`; all checkpoints, DSP design,
reports, metrics, and plots are under `runs/run-N/`.

# Data and protocol

VCTK `wav48` is split by speaker into training, validation, and test groups.
MUSAN `noise`, `music`, and `speech` source recordings are split before
segmentation. Babble is the sum of 3–7 independently selected `speech` sources
from the same recording-disjoint partition. Training augmentation selects its
family and continuous SNR deterministically from `(seed, epoch, sample_id)`.

The VCTK source is the [Kaggle VCTK distribution](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/pratt3000/vctk-corpus);
MUSAN is [OpenSLR 17](https://www.openslr.org/17/). Both datasets must be
downloaded/extracted manually; the pipeline preflight checks the expected local
`wav48` and `noise`/`music`/`speech` layout before cache materialisation.

# Frozen DSP design

The passband is derived only from training speech and training MUSAN pools, then
stored as a run-local artifact. The selected edges for this run are
`{python} DESIGN['selected_edges_hz']`. A Gaussian-noise Wiener positive control
is recorded separately; it verifies technical SNR gain but is not recognition
evidence.

# Results

```{python}
rows = []
for cell in ("raw", "bandpass", "wiener", "bandpass_wiener"):
    rows.append([cell, fmt(mean_accuracy(cell, clean=True)), *[fmt(mean_accuracy(cell, family=family)) for family in CONFIG["test_noise_families"]]])
display(Markdown("| cell | clean | " + " | ".join(CONFIG["test_noise_families"]) + " |\n|---|" + "|".join(["---"] * (1 + len(CONFIG["test_noise_families"]))) + "|\n" + "\n".join("| " + " | ".join(row) + " |" for row in rows)))
```

```{python}
display(Image(filename=str(REPORTS / "snr-curves.png")))
display(Image(filename=str(REPORTS / "factorial-effects.png")))
display(Image(filename=str(REPORTS / "snr-recognition-tradeoff.png")))
```

Factorial contrasts use a paired bootstrap whose resampling unit is the test
speaker; all seed, SNR, family, and query observations for a selected speaker
are retained together. The bootstrap result is saved in
`reports/factorial-bootstrap.json`, not inferred from a DSP SNR gain alone.
